subject: [Action] Procurement sequencing & close plan: MSA / DPA / Order Form (Acme)
messages:
From: Michael Reynolds <michael.reynolds@acme.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Jenna Liu <jenna.liu@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Sequencing: MSA/DPA/Order Form for Redwood pilot

Hi Laura / Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement wants to lock the contracting sequence and a mutual action plan so we can hit a mid-June pilot start. High-level asks from my side: 

- Can you confirm the sequence Redwood prefers (MSA -> DPA parallel -> Order Form) and, critically, whether the Order Form requires a fully executed MSA?
- We need an evaluation plan (success criteria, timeline, measurement) for the 3-week pilot so our product team can budget engineering time.
- Legal would like visibility into any non-standard terms up front; can you share the MSA draft and any common redline items?

Target timeline from Acme: MSA returned to us for review by 5/06, DPA reviewed in parallel, PO and order by 5/20, pilot start week of 6/15. Does that align with Redwood capacity?

Attaching a short procurement checklist we use (see: Proc_Checklist_Acme.pdf).

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can brief procurement.

Best,
Michael
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Corporation

(attachment: Proc_Checklist_Acme.pdf)
From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Reynolds <michael.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequencing: MSA/DPA/Order Form for Redwood pilot

Michael —

Thanks for the clear timeline. High-level sequencing we recommend:

1) MSA execution is required before Order Form activation.
2) DPA can be reviewed in parallel but should be signed no later than Order Form execution (we can provisionally accept signature on the DPA within a short window after order form, depending on data flow for the pilot).
3) Order Form contains pilot scope, billing, and acceptance criteria (we use this to trigger provisioning).

I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and a first-pass evaluation plan for the 3-week pilot — that should make the dependencies explicit. Key dates we can commit to if we get MSA redlines by 5/06:

- MSA redline review complete: 5/10
- DPA review: parallel, complete 5/12
- Order Form final & DocuSign sent: 5/14
- PO received / billing info confirmed: 5/20
- Pilot provisioning window: week of 6/15 (pilot start 6/17)

A couple of notes / asks from our side:
- Please confirm procurement's desired payment terms (Net30 vs Net45). Our standard is Net30 for pilots.
- If Acme requires custom SSO or VPC peering, that may add 2–3 weeks to provisioning; include that in the MAP if relevant.
- Marcus will share our SOC2 artifacts and a link to the DPA template.

Next steps: I will upload the MAP (Redwood_MAP_Acme_v1.pdf) and a plain-text summary of typical MSA redlines that we see attached to this thread. If that looks good, Marcus and I can sync with your legal team for a short redline session next week.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

(attachments: Redwood_MAP_Acme_v1.pdf, Redwood_MSA_Template_redlines_requested.txt)
From: marcus.lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Reynolds <michael.reynolds@acme.com>, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequencing: MSA/DPA/Order Form for Redwood pilot

Adding a few operational items from infra/security: 

- We can provide SOC2 Type II summary and the attestation artifact; attaching SOC2_summary.pdf. Full artifact available on request (secure link).
- If Acme needs IP allowlisting or VPC peering, please flag that now — peering requires an infra ticket and can add 10–14 business days.
- Billing: we require a billing contact and legal entity name on the PO. If procurement uses a purchase order, include the billing address and PO number on the Order Form.

Operationally, we can meet the dates Laura outlined but will need the executed MSA by 5/14 at the latest to keep the 6/17 provisioning date. If legal delays push the sign date past 5/14, provisioning will likely slip into late June.

Happy to jump on a 30-minute redline call with Acme legal — propose Thu 5/7 or Fri 5/8.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect (Redwood Inference)

(attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf)
From: Michael Reynolds <michael.reynolds@acme.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Jenna Liu <jenna.liu@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 16:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequencing: MSA/DPA/Order Form for Redwood pilot

Thanks Laura / Marcus — this is helpful and aligns with procurement's expectations. Quick confirmations: 

- Procurement can commit to reviewing and returning redlines by 5/06 for the MSA. I will send initial comments to you by EOD 5/05 and follow up with Jenna.
- Payment terms: procurement prefers Net45 but will accept Net30 for pilot if Redwood can provide an invoice schedule and a single consolidated invoice at the end of the pilot.
- Evaluation: Acme will run a 3-week evaluation window with the following acceptance checks (we'll send detailed criteria): throughput targets, response latency under 500ms P95 for configured scenarios, and correctness thresholds for core intents.

We accept your proposal that Order Form activation requires executed MSA; Jenna will confirm PO timing once we have redlines resolved. We can do the redline call on Fri 5/8 at 10:00 AM PT — Jenna and I will be on that call.

I'll attach the procurement contact sheet after I confirm with accounts payable. Looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Michael
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Corporation
